name: List and detail
layerWhy: It is a place where the list, the detail and their actions serve the journey of managing things.
promise: Find a thing, open it, change it, delete it, or make one; each at its own address.
expectation: The list beside the open item, or each on its own with a way back.
evidence: Every item opens cold from its readable address; delete has Undo; a new thing opens; the list keeps its state while items open.
behaviour: Narrow, the list or the item shows, with "All reports".
relationships: Next two moves: rename and delete beside the title; New Report above the list.
accessibility: The open item is marked in the list; changes are announced.
failures: Never stops at create: edit and delete are there.
